items.title: Disable telemetry, tracking & targeted ads
items.impact: Some Microsoft personalized features stop working.
items.description: Limits the usage data Windows sends to Microsoft and turns off your advertising ID.

items.title: Disable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows
items.description: Stops Windows showing tips, app suggestions and promotions in Settings, Start and notifications.

items.title: Disable Windows location services & app location access
items.impact: Maps, weather and Find My Device lose your location.
items.description: Turns off location for Windows and every app.

items.title: Disable Find My Device location tracking
items.impact: You can't locate this PC if it's lost.
items.description: Stops Windows reporting this PC's location for Find My Device.

items.title: Disable tips & tricks on the lock screen
items.description: Removes the tips and promotions shown on the lock screen.

items.title: Enable Windows spotlight desktop background and shortcut
items.description: Shows a new Microsoft photo as your desktop background each day.

items.title: Disable Windows spotlight desktop background
items.description: Keeps your own desktop background instead of Microsoft's daily photo.

items.title: Hide the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut
items.description: Removes the desktop shortcut that Windows Spotlight adds.

items.title: Disable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge
items.description: Removes ads, the news feed and suggested content from Edge's new tab page.

items.title: Disable Microsoft Copilot
items.description: Removes Microsoft Copilot from Windows and blocks it from running.

items.title: Disable Windows Recall
items.description: Stops Windows Recall taking snapshots of what's on your screen.

items.title: Disable Click To Do, AI text & image analysis
items.description: Turns off Click to Do, which analyses text and images on your screen with AI.

items.title: Prevent AI service from starting automatically
items.impact: Windows AI features start more slowly or stop working.
items.description: Stops the Windows AI service starting by itself.

items.title: Disable Xbox game/screen recording
items.impact: Game clips and screen recording stop working.
items.description: Stops Windows recording gameplay in the background, which frees up some performance.

items.title: Disable Game Bar integration
items.impact: Game Bar shortcuts and links stop opening it.
items.description: Stops Xbox Game Bar opening with games and controllers.

items.title: Hide recommended section in the start menu
items.description: Removes the Recommended section from the Start menu.

items.title: Hide 'All Apps' section in the start menu
items.description: Hides the All apps list in the Start menu.

items.title: Disable Phone Link integration in the start menu
items.description: Removes the Phone Link panel from the Start menu.

items.title: Disable Bing web search & Copilot integration in search
items.description: Keeps Start menu search on this PC, without web results from Bing.

items.title: Hide Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home
items.description: Removes Microsoft 365 and Copilot promotions from the Settings home page.

items.title: Hide Settings 'Home' page
items.description: Removes the Home page from the Settings app.

items.title: Disable AI features in Microsoft Edge
items.description: Turns off Copilot and other AI features in Edge.

items.title: Disable AI features in Google Chrome
items.description: Turns off the AI features built into Chrome.

items.title: Disable AI features in Paint
items.description: Removes AI features such as image generation from Paint.

items.title: Disable AI features in Notepad
items.description: Removes AI features such as Rewrite from Notepad.

items.title: Enable dark theme for system and apps
items.description: Switches Windows and apps that follow it to the dark theme.

items.title: Use classic Windows 10 context menu style
items.impact: Windows 11's newer menu is hidden.
items.description: Brings back the full right-click menu, without Show more options.

items.title: Disable Enhance Pointer Precision (mouse acceleration)
items.description: Makes the pointer move the same distance as your hand, whatever the speed. Popular for aiming in games.

items.title: Disable Sticky Keys keyboard shortcut (5x shift)
items.description: Stops the Sticky Keys prompt appearing when you tap Shift five times.

items.title: Disable window snapping
items.impact: Dragging a window to a screen edge won't resize it.
items.description: Stops windows snapping to the edges when you drag them.

items.title: Disable showing app suggestions when snapping windows
items.description: Stops Windows suggesting other windows to fill the space after you snap one.

items.title: Hide snap layout flyout at top of screen and on maximize button
items.description: Hides the layout options that appear over a window's maximize button.

items.title: Hide tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
items.description: Shows only windows in Alt+Tab, not Edge tabs.

items.title: Show 3 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
items.description: Shows your three latest Edge tabs in Alt+Tab.

items.title: Show 5 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
items.description: Shows your five latest Edge tabs in Alt+Tab.

items.title: Show 20 tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
items.description: Shows your twenty latest Edge tabs in Alt+Tab.

items.title: Align taskbar to the left
items.description: Moves taskbar icons to the left, as on Windows 10.

items.title: Hide search icon from the taskbar
items.description: Removes search from the taskbar.

items.title: Show search icon on the taskbar
items.description: Shows search on the taskbar as an icon.

items.title: Show search icon with label on the taskbar
items.description: Shows search on the taskbar as an icon with a label.

items.title: Show search box on the taskbar
items.description: Shows the full search box on the taskbar.

items.title: Hide 'Task view' button on the taskbar
items.description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.

items.title: Hide Chat (meet now) icon on the taskbar
items.description: Removes the Chat button from the taskbar.

items.title: Disable Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup
items.impact: Windows stops clearing old files on its own.
items.description: Stops Windows deleting temporary files and Recycle Bin items by itself.

items.title: Disable fast start-up
items.impact: Cold starts can take a little longer.
items.description: Makes shutdown a full shutdown. Fixes some driver and dual-boot problems, but startup takes a little longer.

items.title: Show 'End Task' option in taskbar context menu
items.description: Adds End task to the taskbar's right-click menu, so you can close frozen apps quickly.

items.title: Enable 'Last Active Click' behavior for taskbar apps
items.description: Clicking a grouped taskbar app opens its last window instead of a preview.

items.title: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for the main display
items.description: Always groups windows of the same app and hides their labels.

items.title: Always combine taskbar buttons and hide labels for secondary displays
items.description: Always groups windows of the same app on your other displays.

items.title: Combine taskbar buttons and hide labels when taskbar is full for the main display
items.description: Groups windows of the same app only when the taskbar fills up.

items.title: Combine taskbar buttons and hide labels when taskbar is full for secondary displays
items.description: Groups windows on your other displays only when their taskbar fills up.

items.title: Never combine taskbar buttons and show labels for the main display
items.description: Never groups windows, so each one shows its own label.

items.title: Never combine taskbar buttons and show labels for secondary displays
items.description: Never groups windows on your other displays.

items.title: Show app icons on all taskbars
items.description: Shows every open app on all your taskbars.

items.title: Show app icons on main taskbar and on taskbar where the window is open
items.description: Shows apps on the main taskbar and on the taskbar of the display they're on.

items.title: Show app icons only on taskbar where the window is open
items.description: Shows apps only on the taskbar of the display they're on.

items.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Home'
items.description: Opens File Explorer on Home.

items.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'This PC'
items.description: Opens File Explorer on This PC, showing your drives.

items.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'Downloads'
items.description: Opens File Explorer on your Downloads folder.

items.title: Change the default location that File Explorer opens to 'OneDrive'
items.description: Opens File Explorer on your OneDrive folder.

items.title: Show file extensions for known file types
items.description: Shows file types like .exe and .txt, which makes disguised files easier to spot.

items.title: Show hidden files, folders and drives
items.impact: System and hidden files become easier to change by accident.
items.description: Shows files and folders that Windows normally hides.

items.title: Hide 'Home' from navigation pane
items.description: Removes Home from File Explorer's left panel.

items.title: Hide 'Gallery' from navigation pane
items.description: Removes Gallery from File Explorer's left panel.

items.title: Disable transparency effects
items.description: Replaces see-through taskbar and menu effects with solid colours.

items.title: Disable animations and visual effects
items.description: Turns off window and menu animations, so things appear straight away.

items.title: Prevent getting updates as soon as they're available
items.impact: New features reach you a little later.
items.description: Stops Windows installing new features as soon as they're released.

items.title: Prevent automatic restarts after updates while signed in
items.impact: Updates may wait until you restart yourself.
items.description: Stops Windows restarting for updates while you're signed in.

items.title: Prevent Windows from auto-installing device companion apps
items.impact: Companion apps for devices must be installed by hand.
items.description: Stops Windows downloading companion apps when you plug in a device.

items.title: Hide 'OneDrive' from navigation pane
items.description: Removes OneDrive from File Explorer's left panel. Your files aren't affected.

items.title: Add common folders back to 'This PC' page
items.description: Puts Desktop, Documents, Downloads and similar folders back on This PC.

items.title: Disable bloat in Brave browser (AI, Crypto, etc.)
items.description: Turns off Brave's built-in extras such as its wallet, VPN and rewards.

items.title: Show drive letters before drive label
items.description: Shows drive letters before drive names.

items.title: Show drive letters after drive label
items.description: Shows drive letters after drive names, the Windows default.

items.title: Show network drive letters before drive label
items.description: Shows the letter first for network drives only.

items.title: Hide all drive letters
items.description: Hides drive letters and shows only drive names.

items.title: Show All Apps in Category view (Default)
items.description: Shows All apps sorted into categories.

items.title: Show All Apps in Grid view
items.description: Shows All apps as a grid of icons.

items.title: Show All Apps in List view
items.description: Shows All apps as a simple list.

items.title: Disable activity history
items.description: Stops Windows recording the apps and files you use for its activity history.

items.title: Use the previous Start menu layout
items.impact: Windows updates may undo this or change how it behaves.
items.description: Goes back to the earlier Windows 11 Start menu layout.

items.title: Turn off extra Microsoft Edge features
items.description: Turns off Edge's shopping, sidebar and other built-in extras.

items.title: Stop Windows installing suggested apps
items.description: Stops Windows installing suggested apps and games on its own.

items.title: Stop sharing updates with other PCs
items.impact: Updates download only from Microsoft.
items.description: Stops your PC sharing Windows updates with other PCs over the internet.

items.title: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
items.impact: IPv6-only sites and services may connect more slowly.
items.description: Makes Windows prefer IPv4 when a site offers both. Can help on networks with poor IPv6.

items.title: Stop apps running in the background
items.impact: Apps may stop updating or notifying while closed.
items.description: Stops Store apps running in the background when you aren't using them.

items.title: Show details on crash screens
items.impact: Crash screens show technical details.
items.description: Shows technical details on the blue crash screen, instead of only a sad face.

items.title: Show battery percentage on the taskbar
items.description: Shows the battery percentage beside the battery icon.

items.title: Show detailed startup messages
items.description: Shows what Windows is doing during startup, sign-in and shutdown.

items.title: Keep scrollbars always visible
items.description: Keeps scrollbars visible all the time instead of hiding them until you scroll.

items.title: Keep the sign-in screen blur on
items.description: Keeps the sign-in background sharp instead of blurring it.

items.title: Skip the lock screen
items.impact: You go straight to the sign-in screen.
items.description: Skips the lock screen and goes straight to sign-in.

items.title: Turn on Game Mode
items.description: Tells Windows to put your game first while you play.

items.title: Allow long file paths
items.description: Lets apps that support it use file paths over 260 characters.

items.title: Disable power throttling
items.impact: Laptops can use more battery.
items.description: Stops Windows slowing down background apps to save power.

items.title: Prioritize the active app
items.description: Gives the window you're using a larger share of CPU time.

items.title: Prioritize games and media
items.description: Reserves more CPU and GPU time for games and low-latency audio and video.

items.title: Turn on hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
items.description: Lets the graphics card manage its own memory, which can lower latency on newer cards.

items.title: Remove the menu delay
items.description: Opens menus straight away when you hover over them.

items.title: Remove the hover delay
items.description: Shows previews and tooltips straight away when you hover.

items.title: Close frozen apps faster
items.impact: Slow apps may be closed before they can save.
items.description: Shortens how long Windows waits before closing apps that stop responding.

items.title: Stop services faster at shutdown
items.impact: A slow service may be stopped before it saves its data.
items.description: Shortens how long Windows waits for services when shutting down.

items.title: Stop shortcuts searching for moved files
items.description: Stops Windows searching your drives when a shortcut's target has moved, which avoids long pauses.

items.title: Disable low disk space warnings
items.description: Stops Windows checking for low disk space and showing its warning.

items.title: Disable crash memory dumps
items.impact: Crashes become much harder to diagnose.
items.description: Stops Windows saving memory to disk after a blue screen, which saves disk space.

items.title: Group Windows services together
items.impact: One failing service can take others down with it.
items.description: Runs services in fewer processes, which uses less memory on PCs with little RAM.

items.title: Disable SysMain
items.impact: Apps may take longer to open, especially on hard drives.
items.description: Turns off the service that preloads your common apps into memory. Can reduce disk use on older drives.

items.title: Disable Prefetch
items.impact: Windows and apps may start more slowly.
items.description: Stops Windows learning which files to load early at startup.

items.title: Global timer resolution
items.impact: Can raise power use, and the benefit varies by PC.
items.description: Lets a timer request from one app apply to the whole system, as it did on older Windows. Some players use it for smoother timing.

items.title: Large system cache
items.impact: Games and apps may have less memory available.
items.description: Tells Windows to favour file caching over app memory, which suits file servers more than gaming PCs.

items.title: Block firmware-installed software (WPBT)
items.impact: Anti-theft tools and driver helpers from your PC maker may stop working.
items.description: Stops Windows running programs placed in your PC's firmware by the manufacturer.

items.title: Stop automatic drive encryption
items.impact: New drives won't be protected if your PC is lost or stolen. Back up your recovery key first.
items.description: Stops Windows encrypting drives by itself. Drives that are already encrypted stay encrypted.

items.title: Disable fullscreen optimizations everywhere
items.impact: Alt+Tab can be slower, and some newer games run worse.
items.description: Runs games in true fullscreen where they support it. To change one game only, use its boosts on the Games tab.

items.title: Disable multiplane overlay
items.impact: Video playback can use slightly more power.
items.description: Can fix flickering and black screens on some graphics drivers.

items.title: Fastest keyboard repeat
items.description: Sets the shortest delay and fastest repeat rate when you hold a key.

items.title: Disable network throttling
items.description: Stops Windows limiting network traffic while media plays.

items.title: Disable IPv6
items.impact: Some apps, networks and Xbox features need it. Microsoft advises against this.
items.description: Turns off IPv6 on all connections.

items.title: Disable the SMBv1 sharing protocol
items.description: Turns off an old, insecure file sharing protocol.

items.title: Disable Bluetooth advertising
items.description: Stops this PC announcing itself to nearby Bluetooth devices for advertising.

items.title: Disable news and interests
items.description: Turns off the news and weather feed on the taskbar and in Widgets.

items.title: Disable tailored experiences
items.description: Stops Microsoft using your diagnostic data for tips and recommendations.

items.title: Disable cloud-optimized content
items.description: Stops Windows downloading promotional content from Microsoft's cloud.

items.title: Disable feedback requests
items.description: Stops Windows asking for your feedback.

items.title: Hide the diagnostics notice
items.description: Stops the notification asking you to review your diagnostic data settings.

items.title: Disable handwriting data sharing
items.description: Stops your handwriting samples being sent to Microsoft.

items.title: Disable typing data collection
items.description: Stops Windows collecting what you type to improve language features.

items.title: Disable input personalization
items.description: Stops Windows building a personal dictionary from your typing, speech and handwriting.

items.title: Disable online speech recognition
items.impact: Voice typing and Voice Access may stop working.
items.description: Stops your voice being sent to Microsoft for recognition.

items.title: Disable voice activation for apps
items.description: Stops apps listening for a spoken keyword.

items.title: Turn off SafeSearch in Windows Search
items.description: Turns off adult content filtering for web results in Windows Search.

items.title: Disable search history
items.description: Stops Windows saving your searches on this PC.

items.title: Disable clipboard sync
items.description: Stops your clipboard syncing across your devices.

items.title: Disable clipboard history
items.description: Turns off the Win+V list of things you've copied.

items.title: Disable message sync
items.description: Stops text messages backing up to the cloud.

items.title: Disable settings sync
items.impact: Your settings won't follow you to other PCs.
items.description: Stops your app settings and saved credentials syncing through your Microsoft account.

items.title: Disable connected devices platform
items.impact: Phone Link and Share with nearby devices may stop working.
items.description: Stops this PC linking with your phone and other devices.

items.title: Disable biometrics
items.impact: You'll need your PIN or password to sign in.
items.description: Turns off fingerprint and face sign-in.

items.title: Disable automatic sign-in after updates
items.description: Stops Windows signing you back in by itself after an update restart.

items.title: Disable Wi-Fi Sense
items.description: Stops Windows connecting to open hotspots and sharing hotspot reports.

items.title: Disable app launch tracking
items.description: Stops Windows tracking which apps you open to personalize Start and search.

items.title: Disable error reporting
items.impact: Microsoft can't offer fixes for your crashes.
items.description: Stops Windows sending crash reports to Microsoft.

items.title: Disable the Insider program
items.description: Blocks preview builds of Windows and hides the Insider page in Settings.

items.title: Disable Office telemetry
items.description: Stops Microsoft Office sending usage data and diagnostics.

items.title: Disable Visual Studio telemetry
items.description: Stops Visual Studio sending usage data and turns off its feedback prompts.

items.title: Disable Edge telemetry
items.description: Stops Edge sending usage data and personalization data to Microsoft.

items.title: Stop Edge running in the background
items.description: Stops Edge staying in memory after you close it, and turns off Startup boost.

items.title: Disable the Edge sidebar
items.description: Removes the sidebar and its Discover panel from Edge.

items.title: Disable Chrome telemetry
items.description: Stops Chrome sending usage reports and feedback data to Google.

items.title: Turn on address autocomplete
items.description: Completes paths as you type in File Explorer and the Run box.

items.title: Disable title bar shake
items.description: Stops other windows minimizing when you shake a window.

items.title: Hide recent files in Quick Access
items.description: Stops File Explorer showing your recent files and frequent folders.

items.title: Compact File Explorer view
items.description: Fits more files on screen by reducing the space between rows.

items.title: Add Copy To and Move To to the right-click menu
items.description: Adds shortcuts to the right-click menu for copying or moving files to a folder you pick.

items.title: Add Command Prompt to the right-click menu
items.description: Adds an option to open Command Prompt in the folder you're viewing.

items.title: Add Copy File Path to the right-click menu
items.description: Adds an option to copy a file's full path.

items.title: Add Take Ownership to the right-click menu
items.impact: Taking ownership of Windows files can break Windows.
items.description: Adds an option that gives administrators full control of a file or folder.

items.title: Remove Cast to Device from the right-click menu
items.description: Hides the Cast to Device option on media files.

items.title: Disable Windows Ink
items.description: Turns off the Windows Ink workspace for pens.

items.title: Disable typing helpers
items.impact: Mistakes won't be fixed as you type on the touch keyboard.
items.description: Turns off autocorrect, spell check and text suggestions on the touch keyboard.

items.title: Hide notifications on the lock screen
items.description: Stops notifications appearing on the lock screen.

items.title: Disable all app notifications
items.impact: You'll miss messages, reminders and alerts, including TuneForge's.
items.description: Stops apps showing notification pop-ups.

items.title: Disable the notification center
items.impact: You can't review notifications you missed.
items.description: Removes the notification panel from the taskbar.

items.title: Disable suggested actions
items.description: Stops Windows offering actions when you copy dates or phone numbers.

items.title: Turn on Num Lock at startup
items.description: Keeps the number pad on when Windows starts.

items.title: Keep the hardware clock in UTC
items.impact: On a Windows-only PC this can make the clock wrong after a restart.
items.description: Fixes the clock changing when you dual-boot with Linux.

items.title: Disable Remote Assistance
items.description: Stops people connecting to help you through Remote Assistance.

items.title: Disable Remote Registry
items.description: Stops other PCs reading this PC's registry over the network.

items.title: Disable printing
items.impact: You won't be able to print, including to PDF.
items.description: Turns off the print service, which saves a little memory if you never print.

items.title: Disable the Compatibility Assistant
items.impact: Windows won't offer fixes for older programs.
items.description: Stops Windows watching older programs for compatibility problems.

items.title: Disable search indexing
items.impact: File searches become much slower.
items.description: Stops Windows indexing your files in the background, which reduces disk use.

items.title: Disable the Fax service
items.description: Turns off the fax service, which most PCs never use.

items.title: Disable the data usage monitor
items.impact: Settings won't show data usage per app.
items.description: Turns off the driver that tracks each app's network use. It can reduce memory use over long uptimes.

items.title: Windows Update: security updates first
items.impact: New Windows features reach you up to a year late.
items.description: Holds back feature updates for a year while security updates arrive as normal.

items.title: Windows Update: ask before downloading
items.impact: If you forget, your PC can miss security fixes.
items.description: Tells you when updates are available and waits for you to start them.

items.title: Stop driver updates through Windows Update
items.impact: You'll need to keep drivers up to date yourself.
items.description: Stops Windows replacing your drivers, which suits people who install them from NVIDIA or AMD.

items.title: Stop automatic Store app updates
items.impact: You'll need to update Store apps yourself.
items.description: Stops the Microsoft Store updating apps by itself.

items.title: Safe service preset
items.impact: Offline Files and sharing your internet connection stop working.
items.description: Turns off telemetry, Offline Files and connection sharing, and sets the Maps and Storage services to start only when needed.
